definitions.explanation: The final train of the day on a particular route.

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた→乗り遅れる：04621_noriokureru⟧。
{終電|しゅうでん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time is the last train?

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦あと→あと：09580_ato⟧⟦{30分|さんじゅっぷん}→30分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There are 30 minutes until the last train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}がないと→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧{終電|しゅうでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: If we don't hurry, we won't make the last train.

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}して→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧、⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}った→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I missed the last train and took a taxi home.

notes:
{終電|しゅうでん} is composed of {終|しゅう} (end) + {電|でん} (train, from ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {終電|しゅうでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to catch the last train
- {終電|しゅうでん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: to make the last train
- {終電|しゅうでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧: to miss the last train

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Last trains in Japan typically run around midnight
- Missing the last train is common after drinking parties (⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧)
- Options include taxis, capsule hotels, or karaoke until morning
